BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 144.651, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 16a.+]

[+Data collection prohibited; firearms.+]

[+This section is effective July 1, 2025. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to health; prohibiting health care providers from asking patients or residents about firearms or ammunition; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 144.651, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 144.651, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 16a.

Data collection prohibited; firearms.

Health care providers must not inquire, or authorize any designee to inquire, of a patient or resident about the patient's or resident's use, possession, or access to firearms or firearms ammunition.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective July 1, 2025.
